name: Broken Dagger
description:
About This Game

Broken Dagger is a dark fantasy RPG where your choices shape the world around you. Explore a dangerous land filled with secrets, forgotten ruins, and moral dilemmas—where every decision carries weight.

Inspired heavily by old Bethesda RPGs, the game embraces player freedom, non-linear design, and multiple ways to approach every challenge.

Meaningful Choices

Every quest can be solved in different ways—through stealth, combat, deception, or negotiation. Your actions have consequences that affect the world and its inhabitants.

Non-Linear Exploration

Venture into villages, fields, and ancient dungeons at your own pace. Discover hidden locations, secrets, and unexpected encounters.

Classic RPG Design

Inspired by old Bethesda RPGs, Broken Dagger focuses on freedom, experimentation, and player-driven storytelling rather than hand-holding.
short_desc: Broken Dagger is a dark fantasy RPG where your decisions truly matter. Solve quests in multiple ways, explore a living world, and forge your own path. Heavily inspired by old Bethesda RPGs, it delivers a classic RPG experience with modern design.
